title: Affine residue data for chosen geometric maps
statement:
For the finite family in the chosen geometric maps theorem, choose one source affine residue comparison, one target comparison and one chain representative per index so that each residue homology map agrees with the corresponding derived-fibre coefficient map.

proof.text: Apply picard_derived_fibre_naturality to obtain the common derived-fibre comparisons for the source and all targets.
Apply affine_residue_model_naturality to the source model and use the per-index choice theorem to obtain target comparisons and chain representatives.
